H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H505: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H2672: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H8337: six (as an overplus beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth
H3967: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H2361: Churam, the name of an Israelite and two Syrians
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H730: a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H6942: to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally)
H6999: to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H4635: an arrangement, i.e. (concretely) a pile (of loaves)
H8548: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
H5930: a step or (collectively, stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke)
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
H2320: the new moon; by implication, a month
H4150: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H6113: to inclose; by analogy, to hold back; also to maintain, rule, assemble
H3581: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3557: properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H5178: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
H1270: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement
H8504: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H6603: sculpture (in low or high relief or even intaglio)
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H1265: a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood)
H3844: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
H3772: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H2406: wheat, whether the grain or the plant
H4347: a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence
H3734: properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry
H1324: a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H3791: something written, i.e. a writing, record or book
H160: {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H1835: Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them
H6876: a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (i.e. Syrian)
H713: purple (the color or the dyed stuff)
H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H4284: a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H7513: a raft (as flat on the water)
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H1616: properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
